design.title: Find the perfect balance
design.body: Between minimalism and style: a short, carefully chosen range of clean lines and restrained finishes, meant to still make sense in five years' time. A smaller catalogue and a stronger point of view, so that choosing does not turn into work.
design.bodySecondary: Every season a handful of pieces come in and the ones we have stopped believing in go out. Before a design is signed off it goes through the workshop: it gets assembled, taken apart, loaded with more weight than it will ever carry in your home, and left in the test room for a month. If anything creaks, it goes back to the drawing board.

price.title: Affordable prices, no compromises
price.body: Good design should be within anyone's reach, so we trim the price where it does not show — in the logistics, never in the materials. What you see is what you pay: no hidden fees and no invented discounts on inflated prices.
price.bodySecondary: We work with few suppliers on long contracts, we pack flat so a lorry carries three times as much, and we print no paper catalogue. That margin does not get lost along the way: it is the difference between a €900 sofa and the same sofa at €1,400 with a different logo stitched into the label.
